## PR title

`Apply EXIF orientation when reading JPEG to prevent rotation drift`

## PR body

```markdown
## Summary

Image converter rotated EXIF-orientation-6 JPEGs (iPhone portrait) 90°
clockwise. Photos extracted from documents came out sideways even though
macOS Preview rendered them correctly.

## Root cause

PIL's `Image.open` ignores the EXIF Orientation tag by default. The
downstream OCR + thumbnail steps received an unrotated buffer, so the
rotation only manifested at output time.

## Fix

Apply `PIL.ImageOps.exif_transpose` immediately after opening the image
in `ImageConverter._open`. Two-line addition.

## Verification

`tests/test_image_converter.py::test_exif_orientation_6_normalized` loads
a fixture with EXIF tag 6 and asserts the post-open image dimensions are
transposed (3024×4032 instead of 4032×3024). Test fails on main, passes
on this branch.
```

- Files touched: src/converters/image_converter.py, tests/test_image_converter.py
